li.title: Liberty Prime Project Summary
li.content:
Liberty Prime Project - Summary General Constantine Chase
For over ten years, I've supervised the construction and implementation of the greatest robotic weapon the United States has ever seen.
It was to be the most formidable weapon ever unleashed on the field of battle. Liberty Prime was the answer to the Red Chinese threat.
But how ironic that when Liberty Prime was finally made operational, it was against not Communist China, or any other foreign oppressor.
America's true enemy was right here at home: the Enclave. Those tyrants who would sit behind their fortified walls for over 200 years while the survivors of their mistakes suffered greatly. Even now, even after all these years, I find it difficult to comprehend.
The Brotherhood of Steel, on the other hand, came to the assistance of the downtrodden of the Capitol Wasteland, fought to protect them, and made the ultimate sacrifice.
It is therefore my greatest honor to present to Elder Owyn Lyons the first volume of histories collected from the logs of the Capital Post newspaper.
I think it only fitting that a chronicle of one of America's darkest historical periods is given to one of her shining defenders.

li.title: Capital Post Article (June 3, 2072)
li.content:
Development of Super Weapon Confirmed
By Walter "Street Beat" Munroe Capital Post Staff Writer
In a startling turnaround from their previous policy of complete covert development, the United States Army has confirmed that they are indeed working on a new super weapon, one designed specifically to crush the Red Chinese invasion force and liberate occupied Anchorage, Alaska once and for all.
Speaking at an Army press conference at the Pentagon, General Constantine Chase stated: "No more secrets. The time has come to lay all our cards on the table, so the Chinese can see with their own eyes that we've got the winning hand. The United States Army is proud to announce that for the first time in history, General Atomics International and RobCo have joined forces to create for this great country a super weapon that will leave every single yellow-bellied Red shaking in their Commie booties."
Unfortunately for our readers, that's as specific as Chase is willing to get. While he and the Army are ready for China to know the U.S. is developing a new weapon, they're not quite ready to divulge just what it is, or when it will be ready for deployment.
"All in due time, all in due time. Rest assured, when this weapon is complete, liberty will come to Anchorage... and Hell will follow."

li.title: Dr. Bloomfeld Letter to Gen. Chase
li.content:
Dr. Bloomfeld to General Chase Personal Correspondence
General,
It is with great regret that I must inform you that we are not going to be able to accommodate your suggestion that Liberty Prime be used in the Operation Anchorage field test.
I'm sure you understand my meaning. While I fully support your plan to use General Atomics' new T-45d Power Armor, it would simply be impractical to use Liberty Prime in its unfinished state.
The logistical problems of transporting Prime to Anchorage, Alaska are challenging but workable. However, I am unsure if Prime could survive the ordeal of its first true combat situation in the freezing temperatures of the Alaskan climate.
Prime will be ready for battle, General. I promise you, it will. But on our own terms.

li.title: Diagnostic Report - May 8, 2277
li.content:
Diagnostic Report 5.08.77
All systems operational. Team continues to report minor problems with audio emitters and shoulder mounted mortars.
Scribe Vallincourt reports we are ahead of schedule.

li.title: Diagnostic Report - July 13, 2277
li.content:
Diagnostic Report 7.13.77
Minor setback. Liberty Prime suffered a catastrophic malfunction during yesterday's test. Right arm completely destroyed as well as three adjacent buildings in the vicinity. Two casualties, seventeen wounded.
Rothchild refuses to discuss the matter. Vallincourt believes he is to blame. Somehow.

li.title: Diagnostic Report - Current
li.content:
Diagnostic Report Current
Today we restored Liberty Prime to full operational status. It's official -- we're ready.
After over 200 years, Liberty Prime is finally going to war.
In light of the Enclave's recent actions, what better way to show those bastards that we mean business?

li.title: Lead Scribe's Journal - May 9
li.content:
Lead Scribe Rothchild Personal Journal 5.09.77
I hate to admit it, but I'm a little jealous.
Vallincourt seems to have all the answers when it comes to Liberty Prime. As much as it pains me, I'm forced to rely on him.
I guess I shouldn't be surprised. After all, he's been working with it for years, and we just recently thawed the bastard out. I need to be patient.
I suppose this is my opportunity to play student to his teacher's role, and there's a part of me that still believes it could all work out for the best. Maybe I'll finally discover what that "spark" is - that thing I've been missing.

li.title: Lead Scribe's Journal - July 14
li.content:
Lead Scribe Rothchild Personal Journal 7.14.77
The setback was my fault. Not directly, but I'm afraid my insistence on making modifications has slowed the project down considerably.
But is playing it safe the right course of action? I thought I had figured it all out. I thought I knew what I was doing.
But if that were true, three men wouldn't be dead and Liberty Prime wouldn't be in pieces.
But is it my fault? Or am I right to admit that the disaster has been a positive learning experience?

li.title: Lead Scribe's Journal - August 1
li.content:
Lead Scribe Rothchild Personal Journal 8.01.77
On a personal note, I think I've finally figured out the AVF problem.
In testing my new variant, I discovered it's far more efficient to power the main battery through an orbited electron rather than the direct overload approach. Now there's something I wish I'd known before the "incident."
It was Vallincourt who first suggested trying this approach. I owe him a great deal, and if Liberty Prime succeeds, my gratitude and recommendations will surely prove it.

li.title: Voice Emitter Request
li.content:
Can one of you morons please tell me why Liberty Prime is currently quoting "Alice in Wonderland" instead of patriotic passages?
I would like to get this problem corrected before the robot's first mission tomorrow. I have enough to worry about, do you understand?
Make it happen, people. That's an order.

li.title: Roger Maxson
li.content:
Captain Roger Maxson, United States Army
Age: 52 Rank: Elder (Brotherhood of Steel) Status: DECEASED
Captain Roger Maxson of the United States Army founded the Brotherhood of Steel in 2077, shortly after witnessing the true horrors of the West Tek research facility. After receiving no response from Washington, Maxson realized the government had betrayed them all and declared that he and his men were seceding from the United States. When the bombs fell days later, he and his people survived in the facility and eventually made their way to the Lost Hills bunker complex.
In October of 2135, he was killed fighting a band of Vipers, but before his death he established several of the Brotherhood's core tenets, including their suspicion of outsiders, and their mandate to recover and safeguard pre-War technology.
In his name, the High Elder of the Brotherhood of Steel is given the title "Maxson."

li.title: Maxson II
li.content:
Maxson II Son of Roger Maxson
Age: 63 Rank: Elder (Brotherhood of Steel) Status: DECEASED
The son of the Founder Roger Maxson, Maxson II led the Brotherhood of Steel as High Elder after the death of his father. Under his leadership, the Brotherhood began to thrive and grow powerful. It was his belief that technology was the key to humanities survival, and it was his responsibility to protect that key at all costs.
It was under his reign that the Brotherhood began its long campaign against the various raider tribes of the west. And it was because of his tactical insight, and his commitment to the Brotherhood's core tenets, that they were ultimately successful.
He died peacefully in his sleep in the year 2155.

li.title: John Maxson
li.content:
High Elder John Maxson Grandson of Roger Maxson
Age: 26 Rank: High Elder (Brotherhood of Steel) Status: DECEASED
John Maxson was the youngest individual ever to be elevated to the rank of elder let alone high elder. A brilliant field commander and skilled warrior, John Maxson volunteered for a more hands-on approach to running the Brotherhood.
This personal commitment to leading his people would ultimately be his undoing. On a raid of a Vipers' camp, he and his squad were ambushed and slaughtered. His body was never recovered for proper burial.
A year later, after the destruction of the Vipers, the Brotherhood erected a statue on the spot where he fell.

li.title: Scribe Arthur Maxson
li.content:
Scribe Arthur Maxson Descendant of Roger Maxson
Age: 10 Rank: Squire (Brotherhood of Steel) Status: ACTIVE
Arthur Maxson is the last known living descendant of Roger Maxson, founder of the Brotherhood of Steel. At the unfortunate age of ten, both of his parents were killed by super mutants in the Capital Wasteland. It was shortly thereafter that Elder Owyn Lyons adopted him into the Citadel, and began his training as a member of the Brotherhood.
A studious boy, Arthur always displays an uncanny level of maturity and insight far beyond his years. Some in the Brotherhood see this child as the second coming of Roger Maxson, and it's believed he is destined for great things. So for the time being, he remains under the watchful eye of Elder Lyons, who believes that one day, this boy may very well prove to be the Brotherhood's salvation.

li.title: State of Maxson
li.content:
On the State of Maxson By Scribe Jameson
"What are we to make of Elder Maxson's state? As every Brotherhood Scribe knows, High Elder Maxson chose to abandon the Core Region and move the Brotherhood East, towards the Capital Wasteland. Many called Elder Maxson a fool, and some even demanded that his title of Elder be revoked and given to his second-in-command, Paladin Owyn Lyons.
But Maxson was determined to follow what he believed to be the true tenets of the Brotherhood of Steel, and as a result established the Citadel in what was once Washington D.C. But a high price was paid for this decision, and many lives were lost in the initial journey.
Some of us now believe Elder Maxson may have led us into a trap. Mutant attacks happen with alarming frequency, food and water are nearly impossible to obtain, and we live in a ruin, surrounded by more ruins. Those who do venture into the wasteland to scavenge or patrol either return terribly wounded... or do not return at all.
In a few short years, the great Owyn Lyons, champion of the Brotherhood's traditional values, became the leader of the East Coast chapter. And in Lyons' infinite wisdom, we now battle the mutant horde in an attempt to preserve peace for the local population.
One can only wonder... what would the Founder, to whom Elder Maxson owes his name, have made of this?"

li.title: Diary of Roger Maxson - Vol. 1
li.content:
The Diary of Captain Roger Maxson October 10, 2077
"The soldier who told me they were executing his platoon was right. I was too late. These scientists have been performing mind-boggling experiments on their volunteer soldiers. Grotesque, horrid work. The mind of a madman unleashed.
They call it the FEV... some kind of attempt to make super soldiers to fight the Reds. I'm going to have a full briefing with the science staff tomorrow, and God help them if I don't like what I hear.
This is an abomination of science."
October 12, 2077
"The scientists at this facility, if I can use the word 'scientist' loosely, have been conducting illegal experiments on military personnel. This goes all the way to the top, and even though Colonel Spindel is long gone, he's somehow still pulling the strings behind the scenes.
I'm disgusted with this. What they've done here is... I don't even have words. I can't imagine what all these soldiers have been through, but I'm going to do what I can to make this right.
I just hope Washington is on my side."

li.title: Diary of Roger Maxson - Vol. 2
li.content:
The Diary of Captain Roger Maxson October 20, 2077
"I couldn't even get anybody on the radio. The government's gone. Completely gone. I don't know who launched first, us or them, but it doesn't matter now. We're in a world of shit. I've declared that we're seceding from the Union. If this is how they want to run things, they can do it without me and my men.
We're in the heart of what used to be the United States of America, and it's just... gone. Wiped clean. I thought this was supposed to be the safest place on Earth, that even if they hit the coastal cities we would be OK here. But they did it. They hit us, and they hit us hard. We're surrounded by death. Everything is dead.
We have to get out of here."
October 27, 2077
"We're heading south. We've packed everything we can carry. Amazingly, the winds seem to have blown most of the fallout away from us. We haven't seen any sign of radiation sickness, but I'm not taking any chances. We're all wearing protective suits until we can find shelter.
We're headed for the government bunker at Lost Hills. If we can't hole up there, God help us all."

li.title: Enclave Tactical Assessment
li.content:
Since the Brotherhood-Enclave War began, we've been analyzing Enclave tactics and developing counter-strategies. Here's what we know so far:
The Enclave's primary advantage is their Vertibirds - mobility is their greatest asset. These aircraft allow for rapid troop deployment and tactical flexibility we simply cannot match. Our recommendation: target Vertibird landing zones and fuel depots when possible.
Their power armor is superior to our T-45d models, but not by a significant margin. In direct combat, training and tactics remain the deciding factors.
Intelligence suggests the Enclave is low on resources despite their technological superiority. Extended engagements favor us.
-Knight Captain Gallows

li.title: GNR Battle Report
li.content:
GNR Siege Update
The super mutant siege on GNR has intensified. Three Dog continues broadcasting, but I don't know how much longer they can hold out without our support.
I've recommended to Elder Lyons that we commit a squad to assist, but he's concerned about spreading our forces too thin with the Enclave threat looming.
This is exactly the kind of situation where we need to make a choice about our priorities. Do we protect technology, or do we protect people?
I know what the Founder would say. But I also know what's right.
-Paladin Gunny

li.title: N99 10mm Pistol
li.content:
N99 10mm Pistol Standard Issue Sidearm
Manufacturer: Multiple (various pre-War manufacturers) Caliber: 10mm Auto Action: Semi-automatic Magazine: 12 rounds
The N99 10mm pistol was one of the most common sidearms in pre-War America, issued to both military and police forces. Its widespread adoption was due to reliable performance and easy maintenance.
The 10mm round provides excellent stopping power while maintaining manageable recoil. Brotherhood personnel are issued this weapon as a standard sidearm until they earn the right to carry more advanced weaponry.
Maintenance Notes: - Clean barrel after every 200 rounds - Replace recoil spring every 5000 rounds - Magazine springs should be inspected regularly for wear
Common modifications include extended magazines, reflex sights, and suppressor attachments.

li.title: R91 Assault Rifle
li.content:
R91 Assault Rifle Standard Infantry Weapon
Manufacturer: Stent Security Solutions Caliber: 5.56mm Action: Gas-operated, selective fire Magazine: 30 rounds (standard), 60 rounds (extended) Rate of Fire: 600 rounds/minute (full auto)
The R91 was the standard assault rifle of the U.S. Military before the Great War. Its modular design allows for easy field maintenance and repair, making it ideal for prolonged operations in hostile territory.
The 5.56mm NATO round provides good range and accuracy with relatively low recoil, allowing for effective suppressive fire and precision shooting.
Brotherhood Assessment: While we prefer energy weapons, the R91 remains an excellent weapon for initiates and auxiliary forces. Ammunition is abundant in the wasteland, and the weapon's reliability in harsh conditions cannot be overstated.
The main drawback is ammunition weight - soldiers carrying sufficient rounds for extended engagements can quickly become overburdened.

li.title: AEP7 Laser Pistol
li.content:
AEP7 Laser Pistol Standard Energy Sidearm
Manufacturer: Wattz Electronics Power: Microfusion cells Beam: Focused red laser (visible spectrum) Effective Range: 50 meters
The AEP7 represents early energy weapon technology - reliable but not particularly powerful. These weapons were commonly issued to officers and special forces units before the War.
Advantages: - No recoil - Silent operation - Extreme accuracy - Lightweight ammunition (microfusion cells)
Disadvantages: - Limited stopping power compared to ballistic weapons - Vulnerable to electrical interference - Expensive to manufacture
The Brotherhood of Steel has been working to improve the design, with some success. Our upgraded models feature enhanced focusing lenses and improved energy efficiency, but the fundamental limitations of the platform remain.
Recommended for scouts and stealth operations where silence is more valuable than raw firepower.

li.title: AER9 Laser Rifle
li.content:
AER9 Laser Rifle Advanced Energy Weapon
Manufacturer: Wattz Electronics / Various Military Contractors Power: Microfusion cells Beam: High-intensity red laser Effective Range: 100+ meters Rate of Fire: Semi-automatic (modifiable to burst)
The AER9 laser rifle is one of the most advanced energy weapons developed before the War. It combines excellent accuracy with respectable stopping power, making it the weapon of choice for Brotherhood Knights and Paladins.
Technical Specifications: - Beam focusing system provides exceptional accuracy - Heat dissipation vents prevent overheating during sustained fire - Modular design allows for field repairs and modifications - Typical battery life: 30-40 shots per microfusion cell
The main advantage of the AER9 over ballistic weapons is ammunition weight and capacity. A single soldier can carry enough microfusion cells for hundreds of shots, whereas equivalent ballistic ammunition would be prohibitively heavy.
Brotherhood Modifications: We've developed several improvements including: - Enhanced beam splitters for increased damage - Improved capacitors for better energy efficiency - Reinforced housings for increased durability
The AER9 represents the pinnacle of pre-War small arms technology, and it remains one of our most effective weapons against super mutants and heavily armored enemies.

li.title: Paladin Glade Message
li.content:
I am not Paladin Glade.
I am Paladin Gunny.
I earned that title through years of service, through blood and sacrifice. But they still call me Glade. They use my old name like it means something.
Glade is dead. Glade disappeared years ago on a mission into the wastes. Glade never came back.
But Gunny did. Gunny survived. Gunny fought his way back to the Citadel. Gunny earned his place in the Brotherhood.
So why do they still see Glade when they look at me?
I hacked this terminal because I needed to say it somewhere, to someone, even if it's just a machine. I am Gunny. Remember that name. When I fall in battle, let it be Gunny who is mourned, not some ghost from the past.
Steel be with me.
-Paladin Gunny

li.title: Diary Entry - Sentinel
li.content:
Dear Diary,
Today was amazing! Sarah let me watch the Lyons' Pride training exercises from the observation deck. They were practicing room-clearing techniques and close quarters combat. Sentinel Sarah is so cool! She never misses, and she's really fast, even in power armor.
I asked her if she could teach me some moves, and she said when I'm older she'll show me how to properly kidney-stab someone. I can't wait!
Elder Lyons says I need to focus on my studies first. I've been reading the Codex every day like he tells me to. It's pretty interesting, actually. The Founder was really smart. I hope I can be like him someday.
Tomorrow I start weapons training with Knight Captain Gallows. I'm a little nervous but also really excited!
- Arthur

li.title: Diary Entry - Robot Friend
li.content:
Dear Diary,
I've been thinking a lot about Sawbones, the medical robot. He's been teaching me about anatomy and first aid. The other Squires think it's weird that I talk to him so much, but I don't care. He's really nice and he knows so much stuff.
Sometimes I wish I had a robot friend like Liberty Prime, but smaller. One that could go on missions with me when I become a Knight. That would be so awesome!
Scribe Rothchild says robots aren't really friends, they're just machines following their programming. But Sawbones always asks how my day was and remembers things I tell him. Isn't that what friends do?
Maybe when I'm older and a real Paladin, I can program my own robot companion. I'd make sure it was programmed to be a really good friend.
- Arthur

li.title: The Guardians of Gillyfrond
li.content:
The Guardians of Gillyfrond A Story by Arthur Maxson
In the mystical land of Gillyfrond, there lived a brave order of knights who protected the people from terrible monsters. They wore shining armor and carried magical swords that could cut through anything.
The greatest of these knights was Sir Maximus the Bold. He rode a mighty steel horse that never tired and could run faster than the wind. Sir Maximus had defeated a hundred dragons and saved a thousand villages.
One day, a terrible shadow fell over Gillyfrond. An evil wizard named Malethorn had raised an army of undead warriors to conquer the land. The people cried out for help, and Sir Maximus answered their call.
"I will defend the innocent!" declared Sir Maximus. "No evil shall pass while I draw breath!"
With his fellow guardians at his side, Sir Maximus rode out to face Malethorn's army. The battle was fierce and terrible, but the guardians never faltered. They fought with honor and courage, just like the Code of Chivalry demanded.
In the end, Sir Maximus faced Malethorn in single combat. Their magic swords clashed with thunderous force, shaking the very ground. But Sir Maximus was pure of heart, and his blade struck true. Malethorn was defeated, and peace returned to Gillyfrond.
The people celebrated their heroes, and Sir Maximus was crowned the Lord Protector of the realm. He ruled wisely and justly, always remembering his duty to protect the weak and punish the wicked.
And so the Guardians of Gillyfrond continued their eternal watch, keeping the darkness at bay.
The End
Author's Note: Elder Lyons said this was very creative. Sarah said the battle scene needed more explosions. I'll add them in the next story!

li.title: Song of the Lightman
li.content:
The Song of the Lightman A Poem by Arthur Maxson
In the darkness of the wasteland drear, Where mutants lurk and people fear, There comes a light, a shining knight, Who brings the dawn and ends the night.
With laser bright and armor strong, He rights the wrongs and battles long, Against the tide of darkness deep, He guards the walls while others sleep.
The Lightman walks where brave dare not, Through radiation's cursed lot, He bears the weight of duty's call, To stand for one, he stands for all.
When evil comes with cruel intent, The Lightman knows what duty meant, To give his life, his blood, his breath, To save the weak from certain death.
So raise your voice and sing his praise, The Lightman of these darkest days, For in his heart beats honor true, The Brotherhood in red, white, blue.
---
Note: I wrote this after reading about the Founder's sacrifice and Elder Lyons' dedication to helping the wasteland. Scribe Jameson said it was "quite advanced for my age." I think that's a compliment!
- Arthur

li.title: Guns and Bullets
li.content:
PERSONAL NOTE:
Paladin Kodiak gave me an old copy of Guns and Bullets magazine today (Issue 3: "Street Guns of Detroit"). It's in pretty bad shape but most of the pages are readable.
There's a really cool article about urban combat tactics and close-quarters weapon selection. The author recommends shotguns for building-to-building fighting, which makes sense because of the spread pattern in confined spaces.
I'm going to ask Knight Captain Dusk if I can practice with a combat shotgun during next week's range time. Elder Lyons says I should be familiar with all weapon types, not just energy weapons.
The magazine also has some technical diagrams I want to show Scribe Rothchild. Maybe he can help me understand the internal mechanics better.
- Arthur

li.title: Squire Maxson - Progress Report
li.content:
Personal Log - Elder Owyn Lyons Subject: Squire Arthur Maxson
The boy continues to exceed all expectations. His tactical comprehension is remarkable for his age, and his dedication to Brotherhood principles is absolute. Sometimes I worry that he's too serious, too focused on duty for a child his age.
Today he completed his first solo maintenance on a suit of T-45d power armor under Scribe Vallincourt's supervision. No errors, no hesitation. Vallincourt says he's never seen a squire master the technical aspects so quickly.
But there are concerns. Arthur carries the weight of his name - the last Maxson - with a gravity that troubles me. He feels responsible for living up to his ancestor's legacy, and that's a heavy burden for a ten-year-old.
I try to balance his training with moments of normalcy. Yesterday I found him in the library reading pre-War children's stories. When he saw me, he immediately closed the book and apologized for "wasting time." I had to sit him down and explain that even warriors need to rest their minds.
He reminds me of myself at that age, in some ways. Too eager to prove himself. Too willing to sacrifice everything for the cause. I pray I can guide him to be better than I was - to be what the Brotherhood needs, not what its worst impulses demand.
The boy has potential to be the greatest leader the Brotherhood has ever seen. Or to become a zealot who leads us down a darker path. The choice will be his, but the responsibility for his education is mine.
I will not fail him.

li.title: Field Entry: Mirelurk
li.content:
-***------- FIELD OPERATIONS *-*-*------ ENCLAVE -***------- ----------- ----------- GOD BLESS AMERICA
Field Entry: "Mirelurk"
Kingdom: Animalia Phylum: Arthropoda Subphylum: Crustacea/Chelicerata??? Class: Merostomata / Malacostraca / ??? Order: ??? Family: ??? Genus: ???
After going to enormous lengths to procure DNA samples of hypothesized forebears, we cannot explain why ancestry evidence is present from two vastly different creatures; the Limulus polyphemus (horseshoe crab) and the Callinectes sapidus (blue crab). It's obvious that a mutation occurred, giving this creature bipedal movement and massive growth, but I cannot explain the presence of multiple subphylum markers in DNA/RNA. Given their mystifying origins, I have decided the species deserves its own classification, and have thus dubbed them "Scylla Serrata Horrendus." They can often be found in sewers and caves and should be considered hostile and very dangerous, as their chitnous shell provides excellent resistance to both firearms and hand-held weapons. They are disgusting creatures, and I cannot fathom their popularity as a food source among the citizens of the Wasteland.

li.title: Field Entry: Great American Cockroach
li.content:
Field Entry: Great American Cockroach
Kingdom: Animalia Phylum: Arthropoda Class: Insecta Order: Blattodea Family: Blattidae Genus: Periplaneta
The insect colloquially known as the Radroach is one of the most ubiquitous denizens of the modern American landscape. I believe it to be of the species P. Americana, the American cockroach, albeit a genome strain affected by years of exposure to heavy radiation levels. While winged, they are incapable of flight. I theorize that this is due to the evolutionary failure of the wing appendages to grow in strength commensurate to the surge in body mass. Radroach wings still seem to serve some purpose, however, in inter-species communication. Dark, damp, irradiated habitats, such as the metro tunnels, provide an ideal environment for breeding. Caution should be taken while exploring such areas, but the threat to operatives is minimal, even in great numbers.

li.title: Field Entry: Dog (feral)
li.content:
Field Entry: Dog (feral)
Kingdom: Animalia Phylum: Chordata Class: Mammalia Order: Carnivora Family: Canidae Genus: Canis
Despite extensive testing I cannot further identify the origins of this mammal. It is clearly canis familiaris but generations of mutation have caused it to become its own new breed. An educated guess would place it as Canis Lupus or possibly Canis Indica. Even with the order's characteristically thick skull, the subject's brainwaves have been mutated, and territorial aggression amplified. While domestication is still possible with some subjects, the creature should generally be considered hostile.

li.title: Field Entry: Large Scorpion
li.content:
Field Entry: Large Scorpion
Kingdom: Animalia Phylum: Arthropoda Class: Arachnida Order: Scorpiones Family: Scorpionidae Genus: Pandinus
Based on research, it first glance appears to be an enlarged Pandinus Imperator, but further testing is required to make a more precise identification. The subject's vesicle has mutated to match its enlarged hypodermic aculeus and the neurotoxin now acts on the potassium and calcium channels. Captive subject was hostile and should be considered a minor threat, though they could prove a problem in larger numbers. Anecdotal reports of specimens even larger than those we have observed exist, but it is likely that such reports are exaggerations.

li.title: Field Entry: Molerat
li.content:
Field Entry: Molerat
Kingdom: Animalia Phylum: Chordata Class: Mammalia Order: Rodentia Family: Bathyergidae
Subject most closely resembles a Heterocephalus Glaber with enlargement due to heavy radiation. While much larger in size than generational ancestors, the local variety seems to have similarly low brain function, possibly due to an exceedingly tiny brain organ. Subject's incisors show increased enamel and dentine growth, making them razor sharp. Further study reveals extremely low levels of Substance P giving this subject an incredible tolerance to pain. I will take skin samples of my next subject as I believe the lack of Substance P can be spliced and manipulated for beneficial research, but this theory requires testing in a more fitting lab.

li.title: Field Report: PFC M.Scott
li.content:
Field Report - Prepared by NCO J.Tuckman by audio dictation on behalf of PFC Matthew Scott. PFC Scott's voice is the only source recorded in the following text.
BEGIN FILE; Sir, I encountered three Ferals on my patrol. This was somewhere around 0300 hours, I think, and it was dark, so they saw me first. I discharged my firearm four times, fatally striking two of the three. My weapon jammed before I could fire on the third target, and just then I realized it wasn't engaging. I knew our orders were to report on anything unusual, and well -- I thought that was pretty strange. He actually followed me back here on his own. We put him in the trailer with the other and he's been quiet as you like. Strangest thing I've ever seen. END FILE;

li.title: Field Entry: Bloatfly
li.content:
-***------- FIELD OPERATIONS *-*-*------ ENCLAVE -***------- ----------- ----------- GOD BLESS AMERICA
Field Entry: Bloatfly
Kingdom: Animalia Phylum: Arthropoda Class: Insecta Order: Diptera Family: Tabanidae Genus: Tabanus Linnaeus
Field observation suggests that the Bloatfly is a mutation of the Tabanus horse fly with provocative advances. These evolutionary forebears possessed neither the significant body mass, nor projectile sting of the Bloatfly. Dissection has revealed that this stinger is engorged with living pupae and neurotoxins. These projectiles are capable of incapacitating large prey on which the bloatfly and it's gestating young can freely feed. These neurotoxins are only nominally effective on humans, but can cause localized necrosis at the wound site. This observation is contrary to earlier assumptions that the Bloatfly was primarily a scavenger. The Bloatfly can be dispatched easily with light weapons, but nonetheless present a threat to field operatives, especially when encountered in numbers. They are hostile and can strike before the target is aware of its presence.

li.title: Field Entry: Brahmin
li.content:
Field Entry: Brahmin
Kingdom: Animalia Phylum: Chordata Class: Mammalia Order: Artiodactyla Family: Bovidae Genus: Bos
The Brahmin has been encountered both in domesticated and wild varieties. They are hardy animals, and their utility has made them valuable to humans, in turn allowing these animals to reproduce in quantities beyond what they would otherwise be likely to acheive. They are commonly employed as pack animals. In addition to having two heads, dissection has revealed that these creatures have eight stomachs, but otherwise do not differ significantly from their likely ancestors of the Bovidae Family. Typically docile in demeanor, these creatures are useful as both as beasts of burden and a food source for field operatives.

li.title: Field Entry: Giant Ant
li.content:
Field Entry: Giant Ant
Kingdom: Animalia Phylum: Arthropoda Class: Insecta Order: Hymenoptera Family: Formicidae Genus: Camponotus
I've determined with near certainty that the aboriginal Ants are of the genus Camponotus. My best guess would be that a majority of the ants encountered are black carpenter ants (Camponotus pennsylvanicus). However, given that this particular genus consists of over a thousand different species, classification has been difficult. Prior generations of the genus were only considered a nominal threat to humans, but their social and fiercely territorial nature, combined with the greatly increased mass of current varieties has made them extraordinarily dangerous. The antennae of the ant is the primary sense organ, and soldiers report disabling this to be a successful tactic, as it sends the ant into a frenzy whereupon it attacks anything nearby, human or ant.

li.title: Analysis
li.content:
Subject - Laser Rifle/Pistol Researcher - J. T. Benning
Analysis - Further research regarding Laser Weaponry has not revealed much we didn't already know. Small production run of prototype weapons developed by US Military.

li.title: Critical Components
li.content:
Critical Components - Power drawn from Microfusion Cell is processed through a Wave/Particle Diverter (manuf:Gen Atomics Intnl). Diverters are protected by carbon-fiber housing, preventing frequent malfunction, but when a diverter fails the weapon becomes unusable, and this part is extremely difficult to replace or repair.
Precision-cut lenses focus optic energy. Lenses are prone to damage and can grossly affect precision of the firing weapon's firing mechanism. Lenses are easily replaced with any clear glass, but require a great deal of skill to fabricate.

li.title: Field Operation
li.content: Field Operation - A fully charged cell will discharge 20 bolts from a pistol, and 12 shots from the rifle model. Recoil is negligible compared to ballistic weapons, so long range combat requires less marksmanship ability of the soldier.

li.title: Maintenance
li.content: Maintenance - The chassis are easily opened, allowing the weapon to be serviced in the field. Purified water and a clean cloth can be used to wash mirrored and glass components, slowing wear on the weapon. The weapon can also overheat after a period of intense use. This can be counteracted by submerging the barrel of the weapon in water, which helps cool heat sinks located beneath the chassis shell in that area.

li.title: Vault 108
li.content:
Location: *CLASSIFIED* Occupancy: Four hundred and seventy five Duration: Indefinite Sponsor: Hawthorne Medical Laboratories Purpose: Cloning
In the case of Vault 108, we have an excellent opportunity to test the social dynamics of a leadership vacuum.
The Overseer of the Vault will be provided with a paltry budget and will not have any of the Vault-Tec support he will need to deal with the extraordinary circumstances detailed in this report.
Vault 108's power supply has been designed to fail after approximately 240 months (20 years) of tenancy, meaning the Overseer will have to divert funds away from other Vault systems just to maintain the reactor. This will, eventually, result in budgetary shortfalls that will adversely affect the quality of life within the Vault itself.
In addition, the starting equipment assigned to the vault includes a Genetics Lab with a cloning station. No such cloning station has ever been tested, and we have been assured by our friends at Hawthorne Medical Laboratories that the project is very much in the "experimental" stage.
But just what sort of societal stresses would cause a Vault Overseer to employ such a device? An outbreak of disease? Famine? Random accidents? It is our hope that Vault 108 will delve more deeply into these matters.

li.title: Vault 112
li.content:
Location: *CLASSIFIED* Occupancy: Eighty-five Duration: Indefinite (Simulation) Sponsor: Facilities Division Purpose: Virtual Reality
NOTE: Project under supervision of Dr. Stanislaus Braun, facilities division, vault technologies.
Vault 112 will utilize an experimental entertainment technology developed by Facilities Division, code-named the Garden of Eden Creation Kit. This program is essentially a life support device, only instead of just sustaining a person's life signs, it is designed to place them safely in a self-contained virtual reality.
Should it become necessary for the occupants of a vault to sleep for an indefinite period of time, or merely be kept entertained to prevent rebellion, this device will prove extremely useful.
Vault 112 has been commissioned as a test bed for the technology.

li.title: Failsafe Program Documentation
li.content:
Failsafe Program Documentation
"Dr. Braun,
Here is the revised code for the military training program you've expressed interest in. I'm not sure exactly what you want with it, and I again stress that this program was never designed to be run with civilian equipment.
Frankly, I don't expect any system you have access to can even run it.
But if you can run this program with the failsafes off, as requested... your real-world test subjects WILL die if killed in the simulation.
It goes without saying that, officially, I denied your request.
General Constantine Chase
-----
US MILITARY TRAINING PROGRAM 923-B: CHINESE INVASION
Purpose: Simulate a Communist Incursion on US Soil
DOCUMENTATION CULLED: NEW PROTOCOLS ENACTED
- DISABLE SAFETY PROTOCOLS 1-6 - OVERRIDE TARGET ACQUISITION
WARNING: TEST SUBJECTS WILL EXPERIENCE REAL-WORLD TERMINATION. PROCEED WITH EXTREME CAUTION!

li.title: Dr. Braun Entry: Failsafe
li.content:
Dr. Braun Entry: Failsafe
There are days I consider finally "pulling the plug," as it were, and putting a permanent end to both this simulation, and my life.
That is the reason I requested installation of General Chase's Chinese invasion program, after all. By disabling the safety protocols, I have ensured that each subject in Vault 112 will physically die if their in-simulation avatars are killed.
Real-world death. End of simulation. The perfect failsafe.
At least it would have been, if not for my own misjudgment. I knew, when the simulation first went online, that the secondary safeties those established for all Vault-Tec and military personnel would prevent my own real-world demise in the event of a Failsafe execution. In the end, I would kill the subjects, and save myself.
I wouldn't want it any other way. Or so I thought.
It's true the Failsafe would scare the living hell out of every resident in Tranquility Lane, and lead to their brutal deaths. But then what about me?
I have no ability to disable my own safety from within the simulation. And any other avatars I could create would be driven by the simulation's A.I. routines not actual living, thinking, human subjects.
Where's the fun in tormenting a machine?
And so, the release of the real-world subjects subjects is more than they deserve, more that I could bear. They'd be dead, and I'd be left here in Tranquility Lane, alone and tragically bored for all eternity.
I can think of nothing more unacceptable.

li.title: Dr. Braun Entry: Toucan Lagoon
li.content:
Dr. Braun Entry: Toucan Lagoon
I've finally come to realization that the Toucan Lagoon simulation has run it's course.
I'm tired of the beating sun and ceaseless pounding of the lagoon's waves upon the shore. I no longer take pleasure in watching Simpson wither away from scurvy, or hearing Neusbaum's screams as he's devoured by the mako shark.
I am, quite simply, bored. It is time to reset the simulation once again.
I haven't been skiing in ages.

li.title: Dr. Braun Entry: Slalom Chalet
li.content:
Dr. Braun Entry: Slalom Chalet
Yesterday, Dithers slipped on the chalet's icy stairs, went airborne, and managed to impale herself on the wrought-iron fence. It was spectacular! And completely and utterly random!
Is there anything more sublime than that bold crimson on fresh-fallen snow?
It was almost enough to make me reconsider a change of scenery. But not quite. 23 years is a long enough vacation in the Swiss Alps.
I long for something more... domestic.

li.title: Dr. Braun Entry: Tranquility Lane
li.content:
Dr. Braun Entry: Tranquility Lane
I have surprised myself. I find Tranquility Lane... comforting. Although distinctly American, it somehow reminds me of Kronach, the town of my childhood.
There's beautiful irony with this particular simulation as well. The residents here are naturally at home, naturally safe. When I toy with them, when their suburban illusion is suddenly broken, it's that much more satisfying.
I do believe we shall all remain here in Tranquility Lane for a very long time. A very long time, indeed.

li.title: CONFIDENTIAL - Raid on Rebels
li.content:
CONFIDENTIAL! TOP-LEVEL SECURITY ONLY!
From: Chief Officer Subject: Raid on Rebels
In light of increased agitation from the rebel elements, I have come to the conclusion that we can no longer afford to be merciful to this scum. While some may hold out hope for a peaceful resolution, it's only a matter of time before they decide to take the fight to us. Or, worse yet, our families.
I propose a midnight raid into their compound - live ammo, zero tolerance. Make an example of the first two who fight back, and the rest will fall in line. We may lose a kid or two, but we'll save the Vault as a whole, and that's what counts.
You are not to inform the Overseer and some of our softer security guards about this plan, as they will only object and ensure our defeat. Once the deal's done, they'll see it was worth the price.
This'll show those scum what happens when you step out of line in our Vault.

li.title: Security Dossier: Tunnel Snakes
li.content:
Security Dossiers
Tunnel Snakes
If Butch and his leather-clad delinquents accost Amata one more time, they'll have more to deal with than their acerbic teacher.
Their "services" have come in handy upon occasion, I must admit, but they're starting to become unruly. If dogs become feral, they must be put down. I'll have to remind Butch of that upon our next meeting.

li.title: Security Dossier: Beatrice
li.content:
Beatrice
Just what Vault 101 needs -- an absent-minded, sexually repressed sycophant. Beatrice has served Vault 101 admirably for years, but her mind is growing feeble. I'll have to speak with our good doctor about some kind of long-term pharmaceutical solution.
We may at least be able to keep her comfortable -- and quiet -- until she passes on.

li.title: Security Dossier: Jonas
li.content:
Jonas
I never should have assigned Jonas as James' assistant. He was always too idealistic for his own good. Now he spends every waking minute with the good doctor, who gleefully fills his ears with even more idealistic nonsense.
I've considered re-assigning him, but the truth is Jonas is a fine medic in his own right, and hiding him down in maintenance would be a terrible waste of resources.

li.title: Security Dossier: Amata
li.content:
Amata
Every time I try to get Amata to open up, she just pushes me further and further away. Since she was a child, I've tried to instill in her those virtues that have made this Vault what it is today: loyalty, honesty, commitment, hard work.
She does try, and with a lot of guidance has grown into a fine young woman. That makes it all the sadder that she continues to alienate me. She looks at me and sees the Overseer, not the father that has cared for her alone -- alone! -- since she was an infant.

li.title: Scouting Report 2241-02-10
li.content:
Scouting Reports
Report 2241-02-10
As our tests suggested, the immediate vicinity of the vault is no longer dangerously irradiated, although the background radiation is still well above safe levels. Pockets of more intense radiation appear to still be common, and all surface water seems to be undrinkable. We will need to carry ample supplies of Rad-X with us on all future surveys. But hazard suits do not seem to be necessary for general exploration.
Our old maps are largely useless. The town of Springvale is an abandoned ruin, and all pre-War roads have disappeared or are no longer passable.
We encountered a group of monstrous ants which appeared to confirm Mackay's theories of mutation due to extended exposure to radiation. We drove off the ants with gunfire and collected several specimens for study upon return to the vault.
The good news is that human civilization still survives, despite everything! We discovered a settlement known as "Megaton", whose inhabitants, although somewhat wary at first, soon welcomed us into their town.
We spent a good deal of time in Megaton, and learned a great deal about the "Capital Wasteland" (as the area around Washington D.C. is now called) from them. Megaton is a fortified outpost of "civilization" (of sorts), but it seems that Giant Ants are the least of the dangers of this new world. We agreed that it was prudent to return to the Vault immediately to revise our survey plans in light of what we have learned. Lewis and Agnes remained in Megaton to serve as "ambassadors" and continue to collect information until we return.
Anne Palmer, Survey Team Leader February 10, 2241

li.title: Vault-Tec Instructions - Letter from Dr. Braun
li.content:
Vault-Tec Instructions
A Letter to the Overseer from Dr. Stanislaus Braun:
If you are reading this, emergency Vault internment procedures have been initiated and you and your control group have been sealed into your Vault. Congratulations! You are now a vital part of the most ambitious program ever undertaken by Vault-Tec.
If you have not yet read your sealed orders, do so now. They will outline the experimental protocols assigned to your control group. Please remember that deviation from these protocols in any way will jeopardize the success of the program, and may be considered grounds for termination by Vault-Tec Corporation (as outlined in your Employment Agreement).
Your Vault may or may not have been selected to receive a G.E.C.K. module. Please see Attachment A for details.
Doctor Stanislaus Braun Director, Societal Preservation Program Vault-Tec Corporation
Attachment A: Vault 101 will not receive a G.E.C.K. module, and should operate under the guidelines laid forth in the Overseer's sealed orders.

li.title: Vault-Tec Scientific Entry: The G.E.C.K.
li.content:
Vault-Tec Scientific Entry: The G.E.C.K.
The G.E.C.K. is, quite simply, the most advanced piece of technology ever developed by Vault-Tec -- a terraforming module capability of creating life from complete lifelessness.
After riding out the storm of nuclear Armageddon in a Vault-Tec patented vault, residents can then activate the G.E.C.K., and create a new Earthen paradise -- craters and dust will give way to rolling grasslands and sparkling clear water. Of course, due to time and monetary constraints, not every vault will be equipped with a G.E.C.K. module.

li.title: External Contact Report: "Enclave"
li.content:
External Contact Report
The Vault recently received unexpected radio contact over the governmental Vault-Tec frequency, from an organization calling itself "The Enclave."
Governmental codes are valid according to the Vault's ancient records, and The Enclave put forth an offer of amnesty and unity with the official remnants of the American government, in exchange for access to the Vault and its data stores. They claim that our Vault passwords no longer match their records, preventing them from extending their offer in person.
After brief negotiation, I have refused entrance to this "Enclave." I cannot trust my Vault and its inhabitants to an unknown factor, much less one that would so gallantly suggest abandoning our vault's great mission.
All the more reason to prevent the rebels from opening the Vault to the likes of them.

li.title: Security Dossier: Rebels
li.content:
Security Dossier: Rebels
An alliance of rebels has formed in my Vault, dedicated to the wholly destructive goal of re-opening the Vault to the outside world. Amata and Edwin Brotch are the leaders of the band, with those ridiculous Tunnel Snakes making up its muscle, along with a handful of other youths and naive idealists.
Attempts to isolate and demoralize the group are proceeding apace: Edwin Brotch has been jailed for his attempt to lead a direct attempt to open the Vault's door, and their members have holed up in the old clinic and schoolroom. Their dwindling food and proximity to the dangerous "Dr. Andy" are sure to drain the morale from their rebellion, until they give up and are welcomed back into our happy family again.

li.title: Security Dossier: Amata (Rebellion)
li.content:
Security Dossier: Amata
It pains me dearly to know that Amata is behind the rebellious element in my Vault. If she weren't their leader, it would be a simple matter to break their spirits and bring them back in line with the Vault's time-proven isolation plan.
But with her as a central figure in their rebellion, I must refrain from the more persuasive tactics at security's disposal. I will not repeat the mistakes of that night again. The Vault cannot afford it, and I cannot bear to drive my daughter further away from me.
Despite everything, I take great pride in her natural talent for leadership. When she inevitably comes around, I feel she will make a worthy successor to the position of Overseer.

li.title: Patient File: Freddie Gomez
li.content:
Patient Files
Freddie Gomez
Freddie's VDS is getting worse. Most days, he can't even get out of bed. When he does manage to function, Freddie hides his insecurities and low self esteem behind a bully's mask.
Vault-Tec medical protocols dictate the prescription of anti-anxiety medication when Vault Depressive Syndrome is involved, but do I really want to string the kid out on Chlorpromazine for the rest of his life?

li.title: Patient File: Stanley
li.content:
Stanley
Stanley continues to suffer from severe and chronic head pain. I've been feeding him aspirin like it's candy, but I'm reticent to give him anything stronger. He blames the lighting in his quarters, and though eyestrain is certainly compounding the problem, the headaches are actually a symptom of overwork and lack of sleep.
Knowing Stanley -- and the schedule the Overseer has him on -- the problem isn't likely to get better anytime soon. So it's aspirin, indefinitely.

li.title: Patient File: Amata
li.content:
Amata
Once again, the Overseer has insisted on being in the room for Amata's examination, throwing any inkling of doctor-patient confidentiality right out the window. I know he doesn't trust me; he never has. But I honestly believe the reason he attends his daughter's medical appointments is because he doesn't trust her. That's as ridiculous as it is sad. Amata's a great girl, and the chance of her doing something stupid - pregnancy, syphilis, whatever - is so unlikely it's not even worth mentioning.

li.title: Experiment 27CE
li.content:
Experiments
Experiment 27CE
The cells are still replicating normally. No mutation. Thank God. If whatever's out there could penetrate this Vault, I can't even begin to imagine what the Overseer would do.

li.title: Experiment PP216
li.content:
Experiment PP216
After "borrowing" a few more water chips and rerouting some of the power here in the clinic, I've finally been able to affect the latest sample. It's not much, but considering what I have to work with it, a definite step in the right direction.
But this new experiment was also monumental for another reason: it's the first time Jonas has assisted me. He's suspected forever, I know, so I guess it was inevitable. And his help has been invaluable. I just hope he knows what he's gotten himself into.

li.title: Service Issue Entry V87-002
li.content:
Vault 87 Engineering Section Employees Only
Service Issue Entry V87-002
Maintenance Code: RL00 Green Issue: Dormitory Water Dispensers outputting water with a foul aftertaste Engineer: Daniel Koster
Fix Notes: The water filtration system (the reclaimer) was adding a bit too much chemical rebalancer solution in the process. This gave rise to a build up of alkalines in the water. I've checked with the Medical section, and the water shouldn't pose any health threat. The taste should return to normal in approximately 4 days.

li.title: Service Issue Entry V87-003
li.content:
Service Issue Entry V87-003
Maintenance Code: RL04 Red Issue: Reactor Spikes, Sectional Power Outages Engineer: Daniel Koster
Fix Notes: For the last five weeks, we've had periodic interruptions to the power grid. Entire sections will lose power for approximately 1-6 minutes, then return to normal. By installing monitoring meters, I traced the issue to sudden immense power spikes in the main rector. My fear was the reactor was having a major malfunction, but turns out that it's due to a power draw that the experimental section is creating.
Whatever they are using in there is WAY over the limit for acceptable power consumption. I've temporarily remedied the situation by having the backup reactor kick on when needed. I don't like to do this, but I have no choice until I figure out what they're up to.

li.title: Service Issue Entry V87-004
li.content:
Service Issue Entry V87-004
Maintenance Code: RL01 Yellow Issue: G.E.C.K. Chamber Radiation Purging Offline Engineer: Daniel Koster
Fix Notes: Vault-Tec's crappy handiwork is at it again. I have spent the better part of a month patching and re-patching the radiation purge system that vents excess radiation from the G.E.C.K. chamber. I have no idea why this system keeps failing. I suspect the system is simply inadequate and can't handle the amount of radiation it's purging. Recommend installing a new purging system as soon as I can get one cobbled together from spare parts. Should have it ready in about a month.

li.title: Service Issue Entry V87-005
li.content:
Service Issue Entry V87-005
Maintenance Code: RL00 Green Issue: Tapioca Pudding Miscolor Engineer: Daniel Koster
Fix Notes: The mess hall food reconstitution system is outputting the Monday night dessert, tapioca pudding, in an odd bright orange color. This was a simple fix. The color matrix was simply misinterpreting instructions from the main brain and outputting incorrectly. I replaced the interface and the pudding now outputs in its proper hue. Wish all my fixes were this easy.

li.title: Service Issue Entry V87-006
li.content:
Service Issue Entry V87-006
Maintenance Code: RL04 Red Issue: EEP Chamber Failure Engineer: Daniel Koster
Fix Notes: I was summoned into the Overseer's office and met with Dr. Merrick, who heads up the Experimentation section. He informed me that one of his devices, what he called an EEP Chamber was XXXXEDITEDXXXX. It was a strange device, but I managed to XXXXEDITEDXXXX which didn't fix the problem. I then tried to XXXXEDITEDXXXX which seemed to bring the device back online. I'm not sure what this device is for, but XXXXEDITEDXXXX.

li.title: Service Issue Entry V87-007 - NEED HELP
li.content:
Service Issue Entry V87-007
Maintenance Code: RL04 Red Issue: NEED HELP Engineer: Daniel Koster
Fix Notes: This is the only place I could think of hiding this message. In the event that anyone reads this, please try and get word back to Vault-Tec HQ that something very wrong is going on in the Experimentation section... something they keep referring to as the EEP. My wife, Mercia was "diagnosed" by the Medical section as having some sort of disease they wouldn't identify. She's dead now, and those sons-of-bitches won't even tell me why. From talking to people, I've discovered that many are dead or missing. Checking this with the Medical Records section gets me nowhere. This is getting out of hand. It's time to deal with this my way. They took my wife from me, now I'll take their lives away if I don't get some answers. I've hidden some extra "help" in my safe. Accessing this message will unlock it. If I don't come back, grab that stuff and save yourself.

li.title: Entry 87-34190
li.content:
Vault 87 Chief Physician's Terminal Dr. Wayne Merrick
Entry 87-34190
The latest subjects in the Evolutionary Experimentation Program (EEP) are showing some promise after only a single exposure to the modified FEV. We are currently testing five subjects, two males and three females. Each one of them is under 24 hour observation as usual. We hope to have a breakthrough in this strain as the continual pressure from Vault-Tec and the military at Mariposa is becoming most bothersome.

li.title: Entry 87-34224
li.content:
Entry 87-34224
Incredible results! After only three days, subjects B440, B164 and D624 (all our female specimens) are all exhibiting a unique change. Their bodies are undergoing severe physical changes, losing most of their visible female indicators and transforming to an almost asexual state. They are also seeing increased upper body strength and muscle formation in line with males.
Similarly, subjects C376 and A541 (our male specimens) are losing most of their visible male indicators and taking on the same asexual state as the females. It seems that the FEV wishes to "level the playing field" and start with a clean slate as it works.

li.title: Entry 87-34233
li.content:
Entry 87-34233
We've had a minor setback. Subject B440, Mary Kilpatrik, is now deceased. According to my autopsy, she died of a massive loss of brain function and was unable to sustain her basic bodily needs. This is the usual pattern we see in all the FEV Strains we test... the brains of the subjects becoming too damaged to support even the most basic human needs (eating, sleeping, etc.). So far, all other subjects are nominal and continue to exhibit physical changes.

li.title: Entry 87-34265
li.content:
Entry 87-34265
At ten days, we are now noticing that the skin of all our remaining test subjects is actually thickening and becoming more resilient. This seems to be the FEV bringing about some new adaptive change. This is the kind of result we were looking for... adaptations that could prove useful in combat situations. I need to remember to congratulate Dr. Filo on his skin engineering; his coded instructions in this strain seem to be exactly what he expected.

li.title: Entry 87-34335
li.content:
Entry 87-34335
Once again, I've hit that damn wall. At fourteen days, all of the test subjects began to exhibit severe bouts of rage and anxiety. So much so that they were a danger to my team and to this facility. I had no choice once again but to order them to be destroyed. It pains me every time we do this. The same cycle has been repeated in every strain we test. We always see superior physical adaptations, but the mental changes are their downfall.

li.title: Security Dossier: Dr. Wayne Merrick
li.content:
Vault 87 Overseer's Terminal
View Security Dossiers
Dr. Wayne Merrick
I'm told that Dr. Merrick is one of the brightest minds in the field of accelerated evolution, and apparently Vault-Tec agrees, because they've set up this Vault around him to suit all of his needs in the event that the bombs fall. All of his data and his work have been transferred to this facility from many important sources such as Mariposa Base, West-Tek and Vault-Tec Labs.
I like Dr. Merrick. He's driven without being careless. He knows that in the event of a nuclear war, he may be the only person left in the world that can advance human genetics beyond where they are now. He's meticulous, detail-oriented, and reports everything to me on a regular basis.

li.title: Security Dossier: Daniel Koster
li.content:
Security Dossier: Daniel Koster
An excellent Maintenance Chief. Thorough, careful, and honest to a fault. In fact, that's becoming a problem. His security clearance isn't high enough yet to grant him access to all of the information regarding the FEV experiments performed by Dr. Merrick, but we may have to bring him into the fold soon. In the event we need major repairs on A Level, we'll definitely need his skills.

li.title: Security Dossier: Peter Stevens
li.content:
Security Dossier: Peter Stevens
This gentleman continues to impress me. He was just recently promoted to Technician Third Class by Chief Koster for his ingenuity and ability to think quickly in emergencies. Given these talents, I think he'd make an excellent candidate for Koster's eventual successor if the need should ever arise.
UPDATE: It seems Peter has suffered some sort of a nervous breakdown. He keeps claiming that his "son" is missing and his "wife" is in deep depression, although I show no records of him ever being married or having a child. I've recommended that he be taken to the Test Labs for observation and sedation if need be.

li.title: Scouting Reports: Mission Suspended
li.content:
View Scouting Reports
Mission Suspended
I'm quite sad to report that due to a direct hit from what I presume to be a nuclear weapon on the entry area of Vault 87, we will be unable to provide the Scouting Reports as outlined in Vault-Tec's Operations Manual. The main door to Vault 87 is damaged beyond repair and we are detecting extremely high levels of lethal radiation outside and in the entry tunnel.

li.title: Vault-Tec Instructions - Letter from Dr. Braun
li.content:
Vault-Tec Instructions
Letter from Doctor Stanislaus Braun
A Letter to the Overseer from Dr. Stanislaus Braun:
If you are reading this, emergency Vault internment procedures have been initiated and you and your control group have been sealed into your Vault. Congratulations! You are now a vital part of the most ambitious program ever undertaken by Vault-Tec.
If you have not yet read your sealed orders, do so now. They will outline the experimental protocols assigned to your control group. Please remember that deviation from these protocols in any way will jeopardize the success of the program, and may be considered grounds for termination by Vault-Tec Corporation (as outlined in your Employment Agreement).
Your Vault may or may not have been selected to receive a G.E.C.K. module. Please see Attachment A for details.
Doctor Stanislaus Braun Director, Societal Preservation Program Vault-Tec Corporation

li.title: Attachment A - G.E.C.K. Delivery
li.content:
Attachment A
Congratulations!
Vault 87 has been chosen as one of the very few select Vaults to receive a genuine G.E.C.K. The device was delivered before final sealing of the Vault and installed into its secure pedestal by our special G.E.C.K. Scramble Team. I'd like to extend my best wishes to you and all of your population. Your survival will ensure the continuation of the human race, and to carry the Vault-Tec name into the future.
Doctor Stanislaus Braun Director, Societal Preservation Program Vault-Tec Corporation

li.title: Vault-Tec Scientific Entry: The G.E.C.K.
li.content:
Vault-Tec Scientific Entry: The G.E.C.K.
The G.E.C.K. is, quite simply, the most advanced piece of technology ever developed by Vault-Tec -- a terra-forming module capability of creating life from complete lifelessness. After riding out the storm of nuclear Armageddon in a Vault-Tec patented vault, residents can then activate the G.E.C.K., and create a new earthen paradise -- craters and dust will give way to rolling grasslands and sparkling clear water. Of course, due to time and monetary constraints, not every vault will be equipped with a G.E.C.K. module.

Maintenance Code: RL01 Yellow Issue: Air Conditioning System Odd Smell Engineer: Zack Foxworthy
Fix Notes: This was nasty. Seems when Vault-Tec built this place, they decided to go ahead and parallel route the waste disposal dumping system with the air conditioning ducts. In some places, the ductwork is corroding, which has spread to the waste pipes. So now we have the waste products leaking into the venting. The airflow through the ducts is carrying the smell into most of Men's Dormitory 1, 2 and 5. Had to climb in there and patch it all up.

li.content:

Maintenance Code: RL04 Red Issue: Wall Deterioration D Level Engineer: Carl Maynard

I can only conclude that there is an adjoining underground spring or lake that is putting pressure on the concrete walls. I have already patched the stress fractures and used the metal plating that we normally use for flooring to shore it up for now. I recommend we get all the engineers together on this issue and come up with some sort of a more permanent solution, otherwise we'll be knee deep in nasty groundwater or worse.

li.title: Personal Entry 000897332
li.content:
Overseer Access Only!
Personal Entry 000897332
As per instructions, the broadcast equipment for the White Noise has been rerouted from the sound booths and tied directly into the entire Vault's loudspeaker system. I'll now be able to execute Vault-Tec Confidential Plan WNMSCE (White Noise Mind Suggestion Combat Experimentation). I have three of Professor Malleus's team doing what I need to get done and hope to show some concrete results soon. I had the engineers make it so the WN can be either triggered from the control center or at the local security consoles. The password to these consoles is "UIY2249".

li.title: Personal Entry 000897357
li.content:
Personal Entry 000897357
The results of WNMSCE are even better than I could ever have imagined. The sheer strength and tenacity of combat suggestion implanted test subjects is incredible! Imagine an entire army of people who would never disobey a direct order from high command and can fight until it takes over 20 bullets to stop them.

li.title: Personal Entry 000897377
li.content:
Personal Entry 000897377
Malleus says WNMSCE is a failure. So, there's been a few deaths. One step back, two steps forward. It's easy to suppress what everyone in the Vault are calling "crazies". I've added a command word in their suggestion implants. Simply say the phrase "Sanity is not statistical" and they will stop dead in their tracks. I've informed the guards of this, but I've told them only to use it when out of earshot of anyone else.

li.title: Personal Entry 000897398
li.content:
Personal Entry 000897398
The command phrase is no longer working against the crazies. I don't know what the hell happened, but I'm losing control of the situation. If we don't get things under control soon, we're going to have a huge revolt on our hands. Malleus is inciting the rest of the Vault into action. I'm afraid by the power invested in me by the Vault-Tec Corporation, I have no choice but to have him killed. What a waste.

Three other Vault 92 residents have suffered the same symptoms as Subject V920717. How many more of these people have to die before you realize we're in deep trouble? We're alone out here, no one will come to our rescue... if anyone is even left. We have to deal with this ourselves. We have to consider the possibility we may need to abandon the Vault completely. Better to take a chance outside than in here. You still won't speak to me, and any attempt I've made to see you have ended in scuffles with your guards. It's obvious something's going on and I'm going to find out what.

li.title: Atom's Nucleus
li.content:
Welcome, Confessor. May you walk in the Glow...
Atom's Nucleus
People often innocently ask me "Confessor, why do you worship a bomb?" Like curious children, they come to me with questions about the most visible and perhaps controversial aspect of our faith. The innocent among us hear my sermons before the great symbol, they see us bathe in the waters, and they wonder if it is danger we seek -- a suicide pact, perhaps. And while you may be tempted to answer their curiosity with anger, my gentle Children of Atom, you must never do so.
The core of Atom's philosophy teaches us peace. That we must educate the curious and work towards alleviating their ignorance, that we must teach them to accept the glory of the Division of the past and to seek the glory of the Division that is to come.
Teach them, my Children, teach them how the miserable rotten meat of their bodies will give birth to countless lives at the time of Division. Teach them that they should not mourn the world that has passed, but praise and celebrate those that have already been Divided. Teach them the blessing, the glory, that the peace of our communion and the satisfaction that can be found in our blessed work.
Teach them, my Children. Teach them well, and in the teaching, find your peace and your place. This is the core of Atom's message to us. Spread. Grow. Communicate.
Go in peace, my precious Children. Walk in Atom's Glow.

li.title: Treatise On Atom's Second Coming
li.content:
Treatise On Atom's Second Coming
What is Atom?
Atom is light. Power.
Atom is change.
Atom is the cleansing that brings order to chaos.
Atom is purity.
Atom is peace.
Atom is hope.

li.title: Bringing About The Division
li.content:
Bringing About The Division
I often ask myself if the time is right for the second Division. Here, in Atom's blessed village, are we truly ready for his coming? Have I properly prepared my people for the moment in which his great altar cracks open and reveals to us his glory? I am but a man, who am I to bring these people to glory? Who am I to seek to cause the division?

li.title: Journal entry 001
li.content:
Journal-It Software 2072 PagSoft USER: suk me hahaha
Journal entry 001
Boppo died like a bitch. He didn't have half a bad idea, setting up here. We had a good thing going, picking off caravans and traders on their way into Megaton. He was stupid to try and raid the town. Dumbass deserved the bullet Simms put in his head.
Anyway, there's sweeter water to be had here. That damn Vault's what we should be trying to get into, not that rag-ass town. If we can get in there, ain't none of us going to want again for the rest of our lives.

li.title: Journal entry 002
li.content:
Journal entry 002
Some of the scabs got tired of digging the tunnel and started using mines to get into the caves. Not a half bad idea, the explosions damn near knocked the building apart. We got a new window or two on the side of the building. haha. I'm going to have some of the boys knock over a caravan for more explosives, but we'll have to use fewer in the blasts, or some assholes from Megaton will come looking.

li.title: Journal entry 003
li.content:
Journal entry 003
Hit a goddamned hive of ants in the tunnel. Bastards ate seven of our best diggers before we could lock off the way in. Need to find some way to poison them so we can keep digging and blast into that Vault. If we don't get there soon, I think I'm going to end up like Boppo, except it won't be the Sheriff popping me, it's gonna be my own men.
